issues.detail: Hebrew בַּסִּירִים means 'with thorns' (plural of סִיר, thorn/bramble), not 'with pots' (鍋子). The Chinese '鍋子' is a mistranslation of the noun.
Hebrew גְּדֵרָהּ refers to 'her wall' (the wall of the woman/path), not 'your sheepfold' (羊圈). The Chinese '你的羊圈' adds 'your' and changes the referent from 'her wall' to 'your sheepfold'.
